SPY.title: Risk-On Sentiment Prevails for 2025’s Debut, Fueled by US Stocks
SPY.description: The risk-on sentiment prevails at the start of 2025, driven by the strength of US stocks, while stocks outside the US and US bonds are faltering.
SPY.author: James Picerno

QQQ.title: 1 Tech ETF Set to Outperform as Agentic and Physical AI Transform 2025
QQQ.description: The article discusses how AI investments could drive stronger returns in 2025, with the Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) expected to deliver a 15.5% gain. It highlights the growth in AI-ready data center capacity, the potential for AI to automate up to 50% of tasks, and the push into physical AI with Nvidia's Jetson Thor. These trends are expected to benefit the tech giants in the QQQ fund.
QQQ.author: George Budwell
